correctness.rationale: The printed Section 4.2 choices combine a continuous latent-stage hazard with a boundary transfer. For the displayed transport equation with latent hazard one on ages below rho, characteristics multiply the boundary incidence by exp(-rho). Linearization therefore gives the scalar delay equation with reproduction ratio S0 eta (1-gamma) exp(-rho)/q. At the printed parameters S0=10, eta=0.59, rho=3 and q=100/161, an independent exact-rational replay gives the no-quarantine ratio 0.47292736242633965, so the printed simulation is already subcritical. A deterministic fixed latent residence instead has no pre-boundary progression loss and gives base ratio 9.499, threshold gamma=0.8947257606063796, and ratio 2.37475 at gamma=0.75. The delay characteristic-root argument in RESULT.md correctly proves these are exact linear thresholds rather than finite-time simulation observations.
